win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 14. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: WILD GAS CANISTER SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
When a Green Gas Canister symbol lands, it spreads and transforms itself along with all adjacent low-paying and Wild symbols into Wild symbols. The spread occurs horizontally and vertically, if the transformed symbols will be part of a win. If additional low-paying or Wild symbols are connected to the newly transformed ones, the spread continues, turning those connected symbols into Wilds as well.

 When a Purple Gas Canister symbol lands, it will spread and transform itself and all low-paying and Wild symbols on the grid into Wild symbols if the transformed symbols will be part of a win.

 When low-paying symbols are transformed into Wild symbols, there is a chance that a random Multiplier value is added to that new Wild symbol. Wild symbols created by Gas Canisters can have the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 200x. Wild symbols already on the grid that are affected by Gas Canister symbols will receive a 2x Multiplier value.

 When a Wild symbol with a Multiplier participates in a winning combination, the value of the win is multiplied by the Wild Multiplier value. If more than one Wild Multiplier is part of the same winning combination, their values are added before being applied to the win. The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable. Only 1 Gas Canister symbol can land on the grid at a time.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - COURT OF HIGH STEAM
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game's mechanics. In addition, one Gas Canister symbol is guaranteed to land on every free spin!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 8 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game's mechanics. In addition, all Wild symbols with Multipliers are Sticky and will remain in the same positions throughout the bonus! Wild Multiplier values will double each time they are affected by a spreading Gas Canister symbol. The new Multiplier value will be applied to the wins it's part of on that free spin. The max Multiplier value is 5 000x.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 The skies belong to us!

 Up above the smoke-stacked streets and broken alleys, the Steamrunners own the air. They're fierce, fearless, and wired for rebellion, riding gas-powered gadgets and rogue airships through the floating cities of a fractured world. Their journey takes them through skybound cities to glimmering sky courts.

 Steamrunners is a 5-reel, 4-row payline game where sky-high wins are within reach. Ignite the gas canisters, unleash the power of Wilds, and climb toward a max win of 10 000 times your bet, available in all game modes!

 FEATURES

 WILD GAS CANISTER
